description: Get generated video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something like "generate a 30-second video clip from this scene description", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators who move fast and want to create videos quickly without filming or editing manually.
